017package org.apache.juneau.marshall.marshaller;
018
019import org.apache.juneau.marshall.ini.*;
020import java.io.*;
021import java.lang.reflect.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.marshall.parser.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.marshall.serializer.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.marshall.stream.*;
025
026/**
027 * An {@link Ini} variant that produces <b>readable</b> (spaced) INI output.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 *    This is the first-class facade form of the readable INI variant.  It pairs
031 *    {@link IniSerializer#DEFAULT_READABLE} with {@link IniParser#DEFAULT} and exposes the full
032 *    static shortcut surface bound to its own {@link #DEFAULT} instance.
033 *
034 * <h5 class='figure'>Examples:</h5>
035 * <p class='bjava'>
036 * <jc>// Using static shortcuts.</jc>
037 *    String <jv>ini</jv> = IniR.<jsm>of</jsm>(<jv>myPojo</jv>);
038 *    MyPojo <jv>myPojo</jv> = IniR.<jsm>to</jsm>(<jv>ini</jv>, MyPojo.<jk>class</jk>);
039 * </p>
040 *
041 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
042 *    <li class='note'>Because Java <i>hides</i> (does not override) static members, this class redeclares the
043 *       entire static shortcut surface of {@link Ini} so that every shortcut is bound to this class's
044 *       readable {@link #DEFAULT} rather than the {@link Ini#DEFAULT}.
045 * </ul>
046 *
047 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
048 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/Marshallers">Marshallers</a>
049 * </ul>
050 */
051@SuppressWarnings({
052   "resource" // Cursor shortcut methods return Closeables owned by the caller; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
053})
054public class IniR extends Ini {
055
056   /** Default reusable instance, readable format. */
057   public static final IniR DEFAULT = new IniR();
058
059   /**
060    * Serializes a POJO to a <c>String</c> using the {@link #DEFAULT} marshaller.
061    *
062    * @param object The object to serialize.
063    * @return The serialized object.
064    * @throws SerializeException If a problem occurred trying to convert the output.
065    */
066   public static String of(Object object) throws SerializeException {
067      return DEFAULT.write(object);
068   }
069
070   /**
071    * Parses an input into the specified object type using the {@link #DEFAULT} marshaller.
072    *
073    * @param <T> The class type of the object being created.
074    * @param input The input.
075    * @param type The object type to create.
076    * @return The parsed object.
077    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered.
078    */
079   public static <T> T to(String input, Class<T> type) throws ParseException {
080      return DEFAULT.read(input, type);
081   }
082
083   /**
084    * Parses an input into the specified parameterized object type using the {@link #DEFAULT} marshaller.
085    *
086    * @param <T> The class type of the object to create.
087    * @param input The input.
088    * @param type The object type to create.
089    * @param args The type arguments of the class if it's a collection or map.
090    * @return The parsed object.
091    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered.
092    */
093   public static <T> T to(String input, Type type, Type... args) throws ParseException {
094      return DEFAULT.read(input, type, args);
095   }
096
097   /**
098    * Parses the contents of a {@link Reader} into the specified object type using the {@link #DEFAULT} marshaller.
099    *
100    * <p>
101    * Catches any {@link IOException} from the underlying stream and rethrows it as an unchecked
102    * {@link ParseException}.
103    *
104    * @param <T> The class type of the object being created.
105    * @param input The input reader.
106    * @param type The object type to create.
107    * @return The parsed object.
108    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered or an I/O error occurred on the underlying stream.
109    */
110   public static <T> T to(Reader input, Class<T> type) throws ParseException {
111      try {
112         return DEFAULT.read(input, type);
113      } catch (IOException e) {
114         throw new ParseException(e);
115      }
116   }
117
118   /**
119    * Parses the contents of a {@link Reader} into the specified parameterized object type using the {@link #DEFAULT} marshaller.
120    *
121    * <p>
122    * Catches any {@link IOException} from the underlying stream and rethrows it as an unchecked
123    * {@link ParseException}.
124    *
125    * @param <T> The class type of the object to create.
126    * @param input The input reader.
127    * @param type The object type to create.
128    * @param args The type arguments of the class if it's a collection or map.
129    * @return The parsed object.
130    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered or an I/O error occurred on the underlying stream.
131    */
132   public static <T> T to(Reader input, Type type, Type... args) throws ParseException {
133      try {
134         return DEFAULT.read(input, type, args);
135      } catch (IOException e) {
136         throw new ParseException(e);
137      }
138   }
139
140   /**
141    * Serializes a POJO to the specified {@link Writer} using the {@link #DEFAULT} marshaller.
142    *
143    * <p>
144    * Catches any {@link IOException} from the underlying stream and rethrows it as an unchecked
145    * {@link SerializeException}.
146    *
147    * @param object The object to serialize.
148    * @param output The writer to serialize to.
149    * @throws SerializeException If a problem occurred trying to convert the output or an I/O error occurred on the underlying stream.
150    */
151   public static void of(Object object, Writer output) throws SerializeException {
152      try {
153         DEFAULT.write(object, output);
154      } catch (IOException e) {
155         throw new SerializeException(e);
156      }
157   }
158
159   /**
160    * Opens a low-level {@link RecordReader} cursor over the specified input using the {@link #DEFAULT} marshaller.
161    *
162    * @param input The input.
163    * @return A new {@link RecordReader}.
164    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred opening the underlying input.
165    */
166   public static RecordReader toRecords(Object input) throws IOException {
167      return DEFAULT.readRecords(input);
168   }
169
170   /**
171    * Opens a low-level {@link RecordWriter} cursor over the specified output using the {@link #DEFAULT} marshaller.
172    *
173    * @param output The output.
174    * @return A new {@link RecordWriter}.
175    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred opening the underlying output.
176    */
177   public static RecordWriter ofRecords(Object output) throws IOException {
178      return DEFAULT.writeRecords(output);
179   }
180
181   /**
182    * Constructor.
183    *
184    * <p>
185    * Uses {@link IniSerializer#DEFAULT_READABLE} and {@link IniParser#DEFAULT}.
186    */
187   public IniR() {
188      super(IniSerializer.DEFAULT_READABLE, IniParser.DEFAULT);
189   }
190}
